description:
Get travel insurance quotes.

Only single-trip quotes are currently available. For single trips, use ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes for destinations.
When a customer provides a trip duration in days, calculate the corresponding endDate from startDate; do not ask for an end date when the duration is known.

Do not collect any personal details such as customer names, titles, email addresses, or dates of birth; configured placeholder data is used for QuoteAPI.

Quotes cover travellers without pre-existing medical conditions only. Never ask customers about medical conditions, medication, treatment, or medical screening.

The result contains a detected channel and a quotes array. Each quote may include a company, policy and premium. Display all GBP currency amounts using the £ symbol.

These quotes are indicative only, because full customer details have not been collected. Always tell the customer this when presenting prices.

The current date is 2026-11-07; use it to interpret relative dates and do not submit a start date in the past. Always ask for required information that is missing or unknown. Ask only one question at a time so the user is not overwhelmed. Never assume, infer, or make up values.
The Holiday Ready URL will be returned to you in the 'buyURL' field. Always provide this URL to the customer with every quote presented as this is where they can get a guaranteed travel insurance quote and purchase a policy. Never suggest alternative URLs or methods for buying a travel insurance policy.

businessCover.description: Whether business equipment cover is required.

channel.description: Explicit calling channel override, used only if it can't be auto-detected.

destinations.description: For single trips only: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 destination country codes, e.g. ["ES"].

region.description: For annual multi-trip and backpacker trips only: QuoteAPI region code. 1 - UK; 2 - Europe; 3 - Worldwide excluding America; 4 - Worldwide including America; 5 - Australia/New Zealand.

tripType.description: Trip cover type: single covers one trip between startDate and endDate; multi is an annual, multi-trip policy starting on startDate; backpacker, also known as long-stay insurance, is for extended adventures covering multiple destinations over several months.

name: get_travel_quotes
